newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares end lower after choppy day.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares end lower after choppy day.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Swedish shares ended lower on Thursday after slipping late in a choppy session.
* Stockholm general index down 0.13 percent to 2,663.70
* Office supplier Esselte rises two crowns to 180.5
as it rides on a new options programme for company management. Esselte posts, however, a lower than expected first quarter pre-tax profit of 194 million crowns.
* Forestry shares rose 0.92 percent on positive U.S. trends.
* Drugs major Astra and telecoms group Ericsson both slip.
Swedish shares ended lower on Thursday after slipping late in a choppy session.
The exchange's general index slid 0.13 percent to 2,663.70 in turnover of 3.68 billion crowns.
"It still seems as if the market is waiting for directions," a trader said. Another trader said it looked as if the U.S. had calmed down and shares would not fall further.

Office supplier Esselte rose two crowns to 180.5 as it rode on a new options programme for company management, dealers said. The company posted, however, a lower than expected first quarter pre-tax profit of 194 million crowns.
Forestry shares rose 0.92 percent on positive U.S. trends.
Drugs major Astra fell 2.5 crowns to 347.5 and telecoms group Ericsson edged one lower to 251.5.
Automotive group Volvo fell three to 194 on rumours that the group is planning for a 1997 operating profit of six billion crowns, which would be lower than expected.
Household appliance group Electrolux kept rising, 5.5 to 487 as it benefited from U.S. rival Whirlpool's Wednesday's earnings report.
Fashion retailer Hennes & Mauritz rose 16 to 1,080.
